nodes.label: Bugfix: MONTH_SHORT Crash in financeUtils.js
nodes.rationale: Priority 1 crash. formatSmartDate() uses MONTH_SHORT but the file only re-exports it without importing it locally. Re-export does not create a binding in the module scope. Fix: add named import from './categories'.

nodes.label: Bugfix: Onboarding Repeats Every Session
nodes.rationale: Priority 1. Onboarding check is purely synchronous via localStorage, so it fires on every new device/browser. fetchOnboarded() exists but is not called in Dashboard. Fix: add async cloud check before showing onboarding.

nodes.label: Bugfix: Multi-Tenancy localStorage Isolation
nodes.rationale: Priority 1. LS_PREFIX = 'rattio_' is static, shared by all users on the same browser. Settings like onboarded, salaryConfig, dashSections are in the same key space regardless of logged-in user. Fix: dynamic prefix with userId from base44.auth.currentUser.

nodes.label: Bugfix: Date Input Year Without Limit
nodes.rationale: Priority 1. type='date' inputs allow indefinite year input (e.g., 11/05/20266666). Fix: add clampDateInput utility with max 2099/min 1900 and apply to all date inputs across TransactionModal, Goals, Budgets, CalendarPage.

nodes.label: Improvement: Shared Chart Theme
nodes.rationale: Priority 3. Create a shared chartTheme.js with CHART_COLORS, CHART_TOOLTIP_STYLE, AXIS_STYLE, and GRID_STYLE to apply consistent visual styling across Dashboard and Reports chart components.

nodes.label: Improvement: Mobile Responsiveness
nodes.rationale: Priority 3. Elements overflow on viewports < 430px. Fix: global box-sizing, overflow-x hidden on body, flex-wrap on headers and tabs, overflow-x-auto wrappers on tables, responsive grid columns. Sidebar must start closed on mobile.
